items.html: *Know that the root of these kings is the first name BON, which emerged from the illumination of the Einayim of AK, called the world of Nekudim. And every Malchut that exists in all the worlds was made from this name BON, for there is a Malchut in Arich, in AVI [Aba ve Ima], and in ZON, and they were all sorted by the name MA that emerged from the forehead of AK, which is the male. And you already know that there is no Sefira that is not comprised of ten Sefirot; therefore, in each and every Sefira in all the worlds there must necessarily be a Malchut, made from the above kings.
